item.title: ‘Thanks for giving me new life”- Sarfaraz Khan’s appreciation post for CSK for buying him in IPL 2026 auction
item.description: Sarfaraz Khan shared a heartfelt story on his Instagram account, thanking the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for buying him in the IPL 2026 auction and giving his IPL career a new life. The MS Dhoni- featured side bought the Mumbai batter for his base price of Rs 75 lakh, following the batter's red-hot form on the domestic circuit. item.title: Varun Chakaravarthy attains highest rating points in ICC T20I rankings for India; breaks Jasprit Bumrah’s record
item.description: Varun Chakaravarthy, an Indian spinner, has made history by attaining the highest rating points for India in the ICC T20I rankings. On Wednesday, December 17, Chakravarthy achieved his career-best rating by surpassing bowler Jasprit Bumrah in the most recent rankings update. Thanks to his outstanding stint of 3/14 against England on February 1, 2017, Bumrah was the highest-rated Indian bowler in T20Is, with a career-high 783 rating points. item.title: IPL 2026: “Quinton de Kock buy was a good move,” Ashwin lauds MI for signing Proteas wicketkeeper at ₹1 crore base price
item.description: South Africa’s Quinton de Kock secured an IPL contract with Mumbai Indians (MI) during the mini-auction in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday (December 16). He is no stranger to the MI dressing room, as he spent three years with the franchise from 2019 to 2021.
